name: CaseFlexDirectionColumn
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "flex-direction-column" (layout-flex). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: display: flex; flex-direction: column — the main axis turned vertical
